summary.text: Todd Delmay is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 101 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Hillary Cassel.
He works in hospitality management and, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he has owned a travel agency since 2001.

paragraphs.text: Todd Delmay earned a high school diploma from Fremont High School, a bachelor's degree from Hope College in 1994 and a graduate degree from Strayer University in 2014.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in a working-class family, put himself through college and has owned a travel agency since 2001.
He said he lives in Hollywood with his husband and their son.
Delmay ran in the 2022 Democratic primary for Florida House District 101, finishing second with 34.3% of the vote behind Hillary Cassel, who won the primary with 40.2% and then the general election.
He advanced from the 2026 Democratic primary after it was canceled.

In the 2026 survey, Delmay said he is running to make Florida more affordable, strengthen neighborhoods and support small businesses, and that he wants working families to be able to build a life in the state.
